final: WITH cat AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS q, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS diff FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), m AS (SELECT AVG(diff) AS mu FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.q) AS avg_quantity, AVG(cat.diff) AS avg_diff, AVG(cat.diff - m.mu) AS avg_excess FROM cat, m WHERE cat.diff > m.mu
